newsitem.title: UK: London Electricity climbs on bid talk.
newsitem.headline: London Electricity climbs on bid talk.

text.p: Shares in regional utility London Electricity advanced on Tuesday amid speculation that it may become a bid target of U.S. group Entergy Corp.
The shares rose 25p to 661-1/2p by 0909 GMT.
The Wall Street Journal Europe said on Tuesday that a 1.2 billion stg bid for the regional electricity company could be in the offing.

The Journal said confidential Entergy company documents showed that it was seeking such an acquisition. The target company's name was said to be written in "code' but the financial profile matched that of London Electricity Group.
A spokesman for the UK company declined to comment on the report.
On Monday, Entergy was linked with another possible bid target, Yorkshire Electricity Group. Shares in Yorkshire slipped back 3p today to 743-1/2p.
But a spokesman for the U.S. company said on Monday "We simply don't comment on situations until they get to a point when it is prudent to do so."
